surface: Settings desktop port and pair code
title: Overlapping desktop settings operations can replace a newer choice
reproduction: Hold the initial local engine port read pending, enter or submit a newer port, then let the read settle and inspect the input and saved value.
In one mounted Settings panel, hold the first local engine port storage write pending after Save, choose another valid port, and click Save again.
Release the two writes in reverse completion order and inspect the final Chrome storage value and displayed input.
Repeat with two pair codes: submit the first, enter and submit the second while the first write is pending, then settle both writes and inspect the input and final saved code.
expected: A delayed initial read preserves newer port input and settles before a submitted write; writes to each desktop setting complete in submission order. An older pair-code completion cannot erase newer input. The latest successful submission is the final persisted value.
actual: Pre-fix source overwrote later port edits with the initial read, started storage writes concurrently, and cleared newer pair input after an older write.
